name: push_heart
source: refclips/push_heart.mp4 (480x640, 15 fps, 17 s); read from 15 fps camera crops with an image-pixel grid (stream foot in px) mapped to the M frame through the frames.npz ellipse track (video_extract.image_to_cup, rot -100, y_M = -y_T); tiles in video_targets/push_heart/tiles/

landmarks_M.note: instructor overlay dots in the reliable (ellipse quality 2) frames 10.3-10.9 s; the B->D axis points to about -51 deg in M (not -90 deg): the pitcher (handle at image top-right, spout toward D) is yawed ~40 deg from the Barista's fixed yaw -pi/2. Stream feet of stages 2 and 3 at B agree with the B dot within 0.03 D.

timing_vs_video_obs: video_obs.md takes stage 2/3 times from the subtitles; the frames show stage 2 ending at 8.33 s (not 9.7), the third pour starting at 9.07 s (not 10.0) and the lift/cut at 12.75-13.4 s (subtitle 小流量拉高收尾 appears at 13.4 s, after the pitcher has left).

stages.note: 第一段在B点注入流量: spout almost touching the surface, thick short stream, foot under the overlay B dot (0.5-1.9 s). Cup tilted ~20 deg toward the pitcher: ellipse quality 0 (propagated), so the position is uncertain by ~0.15 D (a fixed level-cup ellipse would put it at (-0.13, 0.08)). Surface stays brown.
同时轻轻的把图案推到D点: the foot slides ~0.17 D toward the near/D side while the cup is righted (image foot (245,295)->(230,312) px); first white ~2.1 s as a small spot at the foot. Quality-0 geometry.

low pour held; the white grows into a C around the foot, opening toward the spout, brown core at the foot. Quality-0 geometry (foot read at 2.27/2.67/3.0/3.4 s: (0.23,0.10) (0.27,0.10) (0.27,0.07) (0.27,0.09)).

pitcher held still in the image while the cup moves ~15 px toward the camera: relative to the cup the foot drifts back toward B (q1 frames: 3.67 (0.23,0.06), 4.0 (0.18,0.08), 4.27 (0.13,0.07), 4.47 (0.14,0.02)). The stage-1 blob ends centred at (0.24,-0.10), r ~0.17 D, its brown bite (impact hole) on the B side at ~(0.13,0.0).
抬高缸嘴收流量: stream thins from 4.5 s, spout rises, no stream from 4.93 s; thin stream lands inside the blob (4.67 (0.18,-0.06), 4.87 (0.19,-0.05)). No tail, no cut.
dry: spout hovers at the far rim and is brought back to B (spout tip touches the surface at the far rim at 5.67 s, foot (-0.39,0.23)).

第二段退回B点注入: stream lands on the B dot (5.8/6.0/6.4 s: (-0.22,0.20) (-0.21,0.18) (-0.22,0.18)); thick stream, spout touching. No new white until ~7.0 s; the old blob is pushed ~0.05-0.1 D toward D and flattens on its B side. Frames 6.0-6.6 have ellipse quality 0 (overlay shown), 6.8 q1.
big flow, the foot moves B->C quickly (7.0 (-0.14,0.12), 7.2 (-0.08,0.09)); first white of the 2nd pour ~7.0 s as a ring around the foot, separated from the old blob by a brown arc.
大流量推到C点: big flow held near C (7.6 (-0.09,0.08), 7.8 (-0.07,0.11), 8.0 (-0.08,0.06)); inner disc ~0.25 D inflates, old blob becomes the outer crescent (0.10 D thick) with a brown gap 0.05-0.10 D.
lift + flow cut: thin stream into the inner disc (8.13 (-0.01,0.01), 8.27 (-0.05,0.01)), gone at 8.33 s. Leaves a small brown notch on the B side of the inner disc.
dry: pitcher raised over the far rim (8.4-9.0 s, no stream) and lowered at the far rim near B.
第三段再退回B点: stream starts at the far rim (9.13 (-0.29,0.37), 9.27 (-0.25,0.30)) and is brought in to B (9.6 (-0.20,0.25)). Subtitle appears only at ~10 s.
大流量注入一个爱心: big flow held at B (10.0-11.8 s feet (-0.18..-0.23, 0.20..0.26)); a small white blob (~0.12-0.15 D) forms around the foot (clearly visible from ~11.0 s), the crescents are pushed toward D.
move B->C with big flow (12.07 (-0.18,0.09), 12.2 (-0.10,0.05), 12.33 (-0.06,0.00)): the B blob is left behind as a detached small heart whose tail is dragged toward C.
held at the centre inside the inner crescent (12.47 (-0.03,-0.04), 12.6 (-0.07,-0.04)): builds the third (central) heart, pushing both crescents outward.
小流量拉高收尾 (subtitle late): pitcher rises, stream thinner and longer, foot runs from the central heart toward D (12.87 (0.05,-0.15), 13.0 (0.09,-0.20)); notch on the B side of the central heart.

foot lingers at (0.04..0.10, -0.18..-0.22) to 13.33 s, then the pitcher is swept away up-left; the brown cut line/stem visible from 13.4 s runs from (0.12,-0.27) to the D rim at ~(0.18,-0.45) (direction ~-63 deg in M).
pitcher gone; pattern finished (cup then shown until 16.4 s, outro scene from 16.5 s).
